notes: Two-page Thai hotel guest guide. Thai is written without spaces between words and wraps inside sentences: a wrapped line inside a clause joins with NO space; the single spaces that Thai uses between clauses are real and kept. Thai sentences are not ended with a full stop. Page 1 places a paragraph (left) SIDE BY SIDE with a box holding a CSS-drawn bullet list (right): reading order is box by box, the paragraph first, then the box heading, then the list items (no marker in item text). The room-rate table has a rule under each row; the opening-hours table is borderless. Rules on page 2: level 0 uses TYPED Thai numerals "๑." "๒." ...; level 1 uses TYPED Thai letters "ก." "ข." (hanging indent; markers are part of the text). Letterhead lines are furniture; page footers "หน้า 1 จาก 2" once per page.
